arxiv-2112-10042.title: The Dirichlet problem for the Monge-Ampère equation on Hermitian manifolds with boundary
arxiv-2112-10042.creator: Sławomir Kołodziej and Ngoc Cuong Nguyen
arxiv-2112-10042.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sławomir Kołodziej and Ngoc Cuong Nguyen. We study weak quasi-plurisubharmonic solutions to the Dirichlet problem for the complex Monge-Ampère equation on a general Hermitian manifold with non-empty boundary. We prove optimal subsolution theorems: for bounded and Hölder continuous quasi-plurisubharmonic functions. The continuity of the solution is proved for measures that are well dominated by capacity, for example measures with L p L^{p} , p > 1 p>1 densities, or moderate measures in the sense of Dinh-Nguyen-Sibony. Introduction Background.

arxiv-2407-15437.title: The classification of links up to clasp-pass moves
arxiv-2407-15437.creator: Jean-Baptiste Meilhan, Akira Yasuhara
arxiv-2407-15437.description: Abstract . We give a complete classification of links up to clasp-pass moves, which coincides with Habiro’s C 3 C_{3} -equivalence. We also classify links up to band-pass and band- # \# moves, which are versions of the usual pass- and # \# -move, respectively, where each pair of parallel strands belong to the same component.

arxiv-2507-22333.title: Streams and Shells Decoded: A Density-Driven Approach to Stellar Clustering in Galactic Halos with AstroLink
arxiv-2507-22333.creator: Viraj Ekanayaka, Smrithi Gireesh Babu, William H. Oliver, Geraint F. Lewis
arxiv-2507-22333.description: Abstract We present a novel method to differentiate stream-like and shell-like tidal remnants of stellar systems in galactic halos using the density-based approach of the clustering algorithm AstroLink. While previous studies lean on observation, phase-space, and action-space based criteria for stream and shell determination, we introduce AstroLink’s ordered-density plot and cluster identification as a viable tool for classification.

arxiv-2510-22650.title: Self-Attention Decomposition for Training Free Diffusion Editing
arxiv-2510-22650.creator: Tharun Anand, Mohammad Hassan Vali, Arno Solin, Green Rosh, B H Pawan Prasad
arxiv-2510-22650.description: Abstract Diffusion models achieve remarkable fidelity in image synthesis, yet precise control over their outputs for targeted editing remains challenging. A key step toward controllability is to identify interpretable directions in the model’s latent representations that correspond to semantic attributes.

arxiv-2602-15805.title: Alain-Sol Sznitman
arxiv-2602-15805.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by 1. In this article we consider a stationary N N -dimensional Galerkin-Navier-Stokes type evolution with Brownian forcing and random stirring (of arbitrarily small strength). We show that the stationary diffusion in an open two-dimensional cone constructed in a companion article, stands as the inviscid limit of the laws of the “enstrophy-energy” process of the N N -dimensional diffusion process considered here, this regardless of the strength of the stirring.

pmc-10647233.title: High-Temperature Chlorination of Nickel Oxide Using Calcium Chloride
pmc-10647233.creator: Peiwei Han, Jingmin Yan, Lunliang Zhang, Zhengchen Li, Shufeng Ye, Tamas Varga
pmc-10647233.description: Attempts have been made to extract nickel from ores and nickel-containing wastes using the chlorination method. However, the use of gaseous chlorinating agents is limited due to their toxicity. High-temperature chlorination of nickel oxide using calcium chloride is analyzed in this study. The volatilization percentage is positively correlated to temperature and CaCl2 dosage and negatively correlated to oxygen partial pressure.

pmc-11489049.title: Vegetarian dietary patterns and cardiovascular risk factors and disease prevention: An umbrella review of systematic reviews
pmc-11489049.creator: Matthew J Landry, Katelyn E Senkus, A Reed Mangels, Nanci S Guest, Roman Pawlak, Sudha Raj, Deepa Handu, Mary Rozga
pmc-11489049.description: BackgroundDiet significantly influences the risk of developing cardiovascular disease (CVD), the leading cause of death in the United States. As vegetarian dietary patterns are increasingly being included within clinical practice guidelines, there is a need to review the most recent evidence regarding if and how these dietary patterns mitigate CVD risk.

pmc-11619983.title: Relationship between EZH2 expression and prognosis of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma using a pathomics predictive model
pmc-11619983.creator: Xulin Zhou, Muran Man, Min Cui, Xiang Zhou, Yan Hu, Qinghua Liu, Youxing Deng
pmc-11619983.description: BackgroundEnhancer of zeste 2 polycomb repressive complex 2 subunit (EZH2) is overexpressed in hepatocellular carcinoma, promoting tumorigenesis and correlating with poor prognosis. Traditional histopathological examinations are insufficient to accurately predict hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) survival; however, pathomics models can predict EZH2 expression and HCC prognosis.

pmc-12549997.title: A US case-control study to estimate infant group B streptococcal disease serological thresholds of risk-reduction
pmc-12549997.creator: Julia C. Rhodes, Rebecca Kahn, Shanna Bolcen, Nong Shang, Yunmi Chung, Monica M. Farley, Amber N. Britton, Ashley E. Moore, Stepy Thomas, Joelle Nadle, Laura B. Amsden, Jacek Skarbinski, Kristi R. VanWinden, Meghan Barnes, Kerianne Engesser, Patricia Ferrieri, AmberJean P. Hansen, Lee H. Harrison, L
pmc-12549997.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Maternal vaccines to prevent infant Group B Streptococcus (GBS) disease have progressed through phase II development and may be licensed based on immunologic endpoints, which have yet to be approved by regulatory authorities. Here we present a multistate case control study to characterize the relationship between serotype-specific anti-capsular polysaccharide (CPS) immunoglobulin G concentrations near birth and infant GBS disease risk reduction.

pmc-13008695.title: Radioactive iodine effects on ovarian reserve: a systematic review and metaanalysis
pmc-13008695.creator: Salwa Q. Bukhari, Hyder Mirghani
pmc-13008695.description: BackgroundDifferentiated thyroid carcinoma (DTC) is common, and its rate is on the rise globally. Radioactive iodine, RAI (I-131), is widely used as an adjuvant therapy or for remnant ablation. There is growing awareness about the effects of RAI (I-131) on ovarian reserve.

pmc-13076531.title: Translating behavioral interventions into virtual reality: the Transcend Framework for immersive health design
pmc-13076531.creator: Rosalba Hernandez, Killivalavan Solai, Soonhyung Kwon, Prasakthi Venkatesan, Drew Fast, Sandraluz Lara-Cinisomo, Harris J. Nisar
pmc-13076531.description: Virtual Reality (VR) has evolved from entertainment to a versatile platform for clinical and public health innovation. In medicine, VR supports pain management, rehabilitation, and cognitive training, and shows growing promise for addressing chronic diseases linked to modifiable risk factors.

pmc-13201799.title: Triggering dynamically disordered lithium sublattice in superionic conductors
pmc-13201799.creator: Chaohong Guan, Jiawei Zong, Jiacong Li, Runxin Ouyang, Yifeng Zhao, Fuqiang Huang, Hong Zhu
pmc-13201799.description: The design of superionic conductors has been largely focused on static structural features, with the dynamic ion transport mechanism less explored. Here, we explore a paradigm that harnesses the polyanion rotations to trigger the dynamically disordered Li sublattice as well as the liquid-like cation diffusion for superior ionic conductivity in crystals.
